def _expiry_warning_order(event, code, expires, **kwargs):
    kwargs.setdefault('status', Order.STATUS_PENDING)
    o = Order.objects.create(
        code=code, event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test', locale='en',
        datetime=now(), expires=expires, total=Decimal('23.00'),
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        **kwargs
    )
    ticket = Item.objects.get_or_create(event=event, name='Early-bird ticket', defaults={
        'default_price': Decimal('23.00'), 'admission': True,
    })[0]
    OrderPosition.objects.create(
        order=o, item=ticket, variation=None,
        price=Decimal("23.00"), attendee_name_parts={'full_name': "Peter"}, positionid=1
    )
    return o


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_sent_once_within_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    o = _expiry_warning_order(event, 'FOO', now() + timedelta(days=2))
    djmail.outbox = []

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.expiry_reminder_sent is True
    assert o.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.expire_warning_sent').exists()

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_disabled_with_zero_days(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
    o = _expiry_warning_order(event, 'FOO', now() + timedelta(days=1))
    djmail.outbox = []

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.expiry_reminder_sent is False


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_not_before_window(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    _expiry_warning_order(event, 'FOO', now() + timedelta(days=10))
    djmail.outbox = []

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_not_after_deadline(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    _expiry_warning_order(event, 'FOO', now() - timedelta(days=1))
    djmail.outbox = []

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_expiry_warning_uses_payment_term_delay(event):
    event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_automatically = True
    event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 10
    # expires is already in the past, but the payment deadline (expires + 10 days) is 8 days away
    o = _expiry_warning_order(event, 'FOO', now() - timedelta(days=2))
    djmail.outbox = []

    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    event.settings.payment_term_expire_delay_days = 4
    # now the deadline (expires + 4 days) is 2 days away
    send_expiry_warnings(None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert o.expiry_reminder_sent is True
